<subject>Re: Sable Creek Logistics</subject>
<body>
Adam:

We told James Austin that we would release our Sable Creek Rail Access and the Legal Opinion at closing on Wednesday. They were okay with that. If that's a problem, I can fax the rail contract and opinion (once I have it signed), with a letter from me saying you can't release it until funds clear...
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au
Sent: Tuesday, 30/04/2024 9:59 AM
To: l157@norcorco.com; kenneth.lee@tasmanridge.com.au
Cc: vincent.james@tasmanridge.com.au; todd.vaughan@tasmanridge.com.au
Subject: Sable Creek Logistics


Good morning.

In order to finish up Sable Creek Logistics tomorrow, please note we need the following today:

Tasman parent guaranty
Rail Access Agreement (so that full payment can be made to Tasman tomorrow)
Legal Opinion

And once funds are received by Tasman, we need the receipt of funds letter.

Matthew, I haven't heard back from the Karratha team to find out if the Bulk Rail contract is ready. Maybe Jake can help shake that loose.

Thanks,

Adam
</quoted>
